title: Sexual Boundaries
summary: Sexual boundaries are your personal limits about what you are and aren't comfortable doing, how, when and with whom. They can change over time and deserve respect.
key_points: A 'yes / no / maybe' list is a simple way to think about and share limits.
You don't have to justify a boundary.
steps: Think about what you want, don't want and are unsure about
Say it simply: 'I like ___, I'm not okay with ___'
Agree on a way to pause or stop
answer_guidance: Explain factually and non-graphically in the user's language (English, Banglish or Bengali). Start with a simple definition and add detail only if asked. Be non-judgemental; mention consent, safety or seeing a doctor only where genuinely relevant.
